title: Study Span in the Added Validity of Imaging and Procedure Authorizations
content:
When an Advanced Imaging Prior Authorization or an Outpatient Procedure Prior Authorization (Referrals & Prior Authorizations) is extended, the study span of the added validity follows the study booked against the authorization:

1. where the study is booked at the site named on the authorization for a date after the valid-through date, the study span is the number of calendar days from the valid-through date to the study date;
2. where it is booked at the named site for a date on or before the valid-through date, the study span is zero;
3. otherwise the study span is the type's extension validity days — 30 calendar days for the Advanced Imaging Prior Authorization and 30 for the Outpatient Procedure Prior Authorization.

## Records read

- The study booked against the authorization is the In-Person Appointments visit linked to the authorization whose status is booked; its clinic location and scheduled date are read from that appointment.
- The site named on the authorization and the valid-through date are read from the authorization.
- "At the site named on the authorization" means the booked study's clinic location is the same site the authorization names.

## Cases (hypothetical authorizations, valid through 2026-04-30)

| Booked study | Study span |
|---|---|
| at the named site on 2026-05-15 | 15 days (30 April to 15 May) |
| at the named site on 2026-04-30 | zero — on the valid-through date |
| at the named site on 2026-04-20 | zero — before the valid-through date |
| at a different site on 2026-05-15 | 30 days — the type's extension validity days |
| no study booked | 30 days — the type's extension validity days |
